title: Beyond the 956: WWE star Bronson Reed dies at 38

content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Jermaine Haley, known to WWE fans as Bronson Reed, has died at 38. WWE announced Friday, November 27, that he passed away earlier that day due to medical complications.

Reed, an Australian wrestler, was a former NXT North American Champion and a current member of The Vision on WWE's Raw brand, where his size, power and signature Tsunami splash made him one of the company's most imposing stars. He had been recovering from injuries suffered weeks earlier at WWE's Crown Jewel event in Saudi Arabia.

In its statement, WWE called Reed a larger-than-life figure and a phenomenal person, a devoted family man and a beloved colleague, and extended its deepest condolences to his wife Paige, who is pregnant, their daughter, his family, friends, co-workers and fans.

Sources: WWE, Men's Journal, PR Wrestling
